Graded — PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack` (#6023), session `session_012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`.

The measurement is the same one #14436 / PR #15461 was written against, applied to `chart-field-unknown`. The card correctly separates the fact (the pinned renderer refuses `xAxis.field` / `yAxis[].field` / `series[].name` as bindings, so "the query result will not contain" never happens) from the product judgement (whether an authored key that names nothing the widget selected should still block). Ruling for the dispatch: keep it a finding, drop it from `error` to `warning`, and reword the message to the true consequence (the key is ignored, the mark/presentation lands on nothing). Queued as `domain:devx` / `pm:queue`, P3, serial on `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts` behind PR #15461 and #15462.

P3, S, ruling from the grade (5543882362): keep `chart-field-unknown` as a finding, drop the three `chartConfig` binding keys (`xAxis.field`, `yAxis[].field`, `series[].name`) from `error` to `warning` (suppressible), and reword the message to the TRUE consequence at the pinned renderer (the key is ignored / the presentation lands on nothing) instead of "the query result will not contain"; any other position the rule covers keeps its tier. Serial on `packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts`: #15507 merged 20:13Z; no open PR touches the file (scan at claim time). Assignee field was empty at the read immediately before this write.
